# Mapbox logo

`mapbox-logo.svg` is the original, unmodified SVG decoded from the official
Mapbox.js 3.3.1 stylesheet's `.mapbox-logo.mapbox-logo-true` image.
Source: https://api.mapbox.com/mapbox.js/v3.3.1/mapbox.css
Retrieved: 2026-09-29.
SHA-256: `1279c23abe5ab9940e2df37f1f61e2e8103e175c20f99510308b7adbff3f9517`.

Mapbox is a Mapbox trademark. This asset is used solely to credit Mapbox maps;

https://docs.mapbox.com/help/dive-deeper/attribution/
